added: English free text, Caller's Companion English imports and Re-check unrecognized figures read more wordings: "Ones pass P by R" is the ones changing places by the right; "Turn single right face P" is a turn single with the note "end facing partners"; passes in brackets after rights and lefts or a circular hey, such as "(PR, NL, PR, NL)" (partner right, neighbor left), name who it starts with and its first side; and "lefts and rights" is read.
changed: "Cross and go below", and "cross and go outside below the twos who move up", are a change of places by the right and a cast down one place, with the twos moving up kept as the note.

`parseEcdFigureLine` reads `cross … and go below` as `ecd_change_places` (hand right, or the cross's stated side) then the cast; a couple's `pass P by <side>` as `ecd_change_places`; `face P`/`face N` on a turn single as its note; a `(PR, NL, …)` note on rights and lefts or a circular hey as `whom` and the first `hand`/`shoulder`; `lefts and rights`; and `cross by <side>` as the cross's side.
